history.title: Why a Beautiful Patio Still Feels Like Furniture Placed Outside
history.description: A patio can have beautiful furniture and still lack the hierarchy of a real room. Veluce Studio’s Luxury Outdoor Room Planner uses a five-layer method, layout recipes and measured planning tools to turn outdoor inspiration into a space that works.
